tldr: **台股盤中震盪逾千點，終場小跌至 43,360.66 點，台積電下挫 2.11%。**
**金管會核准台新銀併新光銀，合併後總資產約 4.7 兆元、分行數躍居國銀第二。**
**資金輪動至 AI 供應鏈（記憶體、CPO、AI 伺服器），為指數提供支撐。**

items.title_en: TAIEX closes near flat at 43,360.66 after a 1,000-point intraday swing (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週二終場僅跌 25.75 點、跌幅 0.06%，收在 43,360.66 點，但平淡收盤掩蓋劇烈震盪：盤中一度跌破 43,000 點，隨後反彈至 43,912.77 點高點，振幅逾千點，成交量約 1.04 兆元。盤面並非全面殺盤，而是強烈的類股輪動，指數表面持穩、資金於檯面下換手。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index ended Tuesday down just 25.75 points, or 0.06%, at 43,360.66, but the calm close masked a wild session: the index briefly broke below 43,000 before rallying to an intraday high of 43,912.77, a swing of more than 1,000 points, on turnover of about NT$1.04 trillion. Rather than broad selling, trading reflected heavy sector rotation, leaving the headline index steady while flows shifted beneath the surface.

items.title_en: TSMC falls 2.11% to NT$2,320, shedding NT$1.3tn in market value (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 台積電下跌 50 元、跌幅 2.11%，收在 2,320 元，為當日市值減損最多個股，市值降至約 60.16 兆元。作為權值王，台積電走弱是拖累大盤主因；但因資金轉進記憶體、CPO 與 AI 伺服器族群，大盤仍守穩，市場情緒未因權值股回檔而全面轉弱。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Semiconductor dropped NT$50, or 2.11%, to close at NT$2,320, recording the single largest market-cap loss of the session and ending the day valued at about NT$60.16 trillion. As the index's dominant weighting, TSMC's slide was the main drag on the TAIEX, yet the broader market held up as investors rotated into memory, co-packaged optics and AI-server names, keeping overall sentiment resilient despite the chip giant's pullback.

items.title_zh: 資金輪動記憶體、CPO 與 AI 伺服器供應鏈（2026-08-04）
items.title_en: Investors rotate into memory, CPO and AI-server supply chains (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 台積電承壓之際，買盤週二轉向更廣的 AI 硬體族群，青睞基本面與訂單能見度較佳的記憶體、共同封裝光學（CPO）與 AI 伺服器組裝廠。此輪動顯示台灣科技優勢正由先進製程晶圓代工，向高頻寬記憶體與光互連擴散，使 AI 建置紅利擴及更廣的零組件與系統生態圈。
items.summary_en: With TSMC under pressure, buying spread across the broader AI hardware complex on Tuesday, favouring memory makers, co-packaged optics (CPO) suppliers and AI-server assemblers seen as having strong fundamentals and order visibility. The rotation underscores how Taiwan's tech leadership is broadening beyond leading-edge foundry into high-bandwidth memory and optical interconnect, spreading the benefits of the AI build-out across a wider slice of the island's component and systems ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 台達電撐盤、抵銷權值股拖累（2026-08-04）
items.title_en: Delta Electronics helps cushion the index as heavyweights wobble (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 電源與零組件大廠台達電於週二震盪盤中明顯撐盤，抵銷部分台積電等大型科技股的下拉力道。台達電走強反映 AI 資料中心與伺服器建置帶動的電源與散熱需求穩健，使其成為今年推升台灣硬體供應鏈之基礎建設投資的主要受惠者之一。
items.summary_en: Component and power-management maker Delta Electronics provided notable support to the TAIEX during Tuesday's volatile session, offsetting part of the drag from TSMC and other large-cap tech names. Delta's strength reflects steady demand for power and thermal solutions tied to AI data-centre and server build-outs, positioning it as a key beneficiary of the same infrastructure spending that is powering Taiwan's broader hardware supply chain this year.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准台新銀併新光銀、打造 4.7 兆元大行（2026-08-04）
items.title_en: FSC approves Taishin–Shin Kong bank merger, creating NT$4.7tn lender (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 金管會核准台新銀行合併新光銀行，合併基準日暫定 2027 年 1 月 1 日，以台新銀行為存續銀行。合併後總資產約 4.7 兆元、資本額約 1,703 億元，為國內第七大銀行；國內 204 家分行數僅次於合庫、居國銀第二。金管會並要求須確保核心系統穩定切換與客戶交易不中斷。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission cleared Taishin International Bank's absorption of Shin Kong Bank, with a tentative effective date of Jan 1, 2027 and Taishin as the surviving entity. The combined bank will hold about NT$4.7 trillion in assets and roughly NT$170.3 billion in capital, ranking as Taiwan's seventh-largest bank, while its 204 domestic branches will trail only Taiwan Cooperative Bank. Regulators stressed that core-system integration must ensure a stable switchover and uninterrupted customer transactions.

items.title_zh: 金管會預告修正保險業財報編製準則（2026-08-04）
items.title_en: FSC pre-announces amendments to insurers' financial reporting rules (2026-08-04)
items.summary_zh: 金管會預告修正保險業財務報告編製準則，配合 IFRS 17 與新清償能力制度上路，優化財報之表達與揭露。此舉旨在強化保險業資產負債與準備金揭露透明度，在業者調適公允價值會計與更高資本標準之際，讓投資人與保戶更清楚掌握其財務體質。
items.summary_en: The commission issued a draft revision to the guidelines governing insurers' financial statements, aiming to improve the presentation and disclosure of their reports as the sector operates under IFRS 17 and the new solvency regime. The changes are intended to sharpen transparency around insurers' balance sheets and reserves, giving investors and policyholders a clearer view of financial health at a time when the industry is adjusting to fair-value accounting and higher capital standards.

items.title_zh: 銀行高資產「財管 2.0」規模成長 2.7 倍至 2.7 兆元
items.title_en: Banks' high-asset "Wealth Management 2.0" AUM grows 2.7x to NT$2.7tn
items.summary_zh: 在亞洲資產管理中心政策推動下，銀行高資產業務管理資產已成長 2.7 倍至約 2.7 兆元，截至 2026 年 5 月服務約 2.5 萬名客戶；政策上路以來全業 AUM 增逾 10 兆元，超過兩年目標的兩倍。快速擴張顯示國銀爭搶超高資產客群競爭加劇，並強化台北打造區域財富管理中心之企圖。
items.summary_en: Under Taiwan's Asia Asset Management Center push, banks' high-net-worth business has expanded 2.7-fold to about NT$2.7 trillion in assets under management, serving some 25,000 clients as of May 2026, while industry-wide AUM has risen more than NT$10 trillion since the policy launched — over double its two-year target. The rapid build-out signals intensifying competition among domestic banks for ultra-high-net-worth clients and reinforces Taipei's ambition as a regional wealth hub.

items.title_zh: 家族辦公室與另類資產成超高資產客群焦點
items.title_en: Family offices and alternative assets take centre stage for UHNW clients
items.summary_zh: 近期業界報告與論壇指出，台灣超高資產家族正轉向家族辦公室、私募與另類資產配置，以及跨境稅務與傳承規劃。銀行由單一商品銷售轉向以整體財富「資產池」融資與治理為核心的整合式顧問，並推出未指定受益人信託等創新。此趨勢重塑私銀競爭樣貌，強調家族價值延續與長期架構規劃，而非交易型商品銷售。
items.summary_en: Recent industry reports and forums highlight a shift among Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth families toward family offices, private-market and alternative-asset allocations, and cross-border tax and succession planning. Banks are moving from single-product selling to integrated advisory built around whole-of-wealth "asset pool" financing and governance, with innovations such as unspecified-beneficiary trusts. The trend reshapes how private banks compete, emphasising continuity of family values and long-horizon structuring over transactional product sales.
